name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
shortDescription: Provides direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to eligible farmer families in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each.
fullDescription: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector scheme that provides income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring various inputs related to agriculture as well as domestic needs. The amount is directly transferred to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.
eligibility: Not a current or former Constitutional post holder
Not a retired or serving officer/employee of Central/State government

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
shortDescription: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases at very low premium rates.
fullDescription: PMFBY provides comprehensive risk coverage against crop loss/damage due to prevented sowing, mid-season adversities, post-harvest losses, localized calamities, and natural calamities. Premium rates are very low — 1.5–2% of sum insured for Rabi crops, 2% for Kharif food and oilseed crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops.
benefits: Coverage against crop loss due to natural calamities
Coverage for pre/post sowing, mid-season, and post-harvest losses
No upper limit on government subsidy
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
shortDescription: Supports efficient irrigation systems and promotes water conservation through micro-irrigation technologies like drip and sprinkler irrigation.
fullDescription: PMKSY aims to achieve convergence of investments in irrigation at the field level, expand cultivable area under assured irrigation (Har Khet Ko Pani), improve on-farm water use efficiency to reduce wastage, and enhance the adoption of precision-irrigation and other water saving technologies (More Crop Per Drop).
benefits: 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers on drip & sprinkler systems
financialBenefit: Up to 55% subsidy on irrigation systems

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
shortDescription: Provides soil testing reports and fertilizer recommendations to farmers for improving crop productivity and reducing input costs.
fullDescription: The Soil Health Card Scheme assists State Governments to issue Soil Health Cards to all farmers in the country. The card shows soil health status and carries crop-wise recommendations for nutrients and fertilizers required for improving soil health and its fertility. Soil testing is done every 2 years.
eligibility: No income or land size restriction

name: Kisan Credit Card
shortDescription: Offers affordable credit facilities to farmers for agriculture and allied activities at concessional interest rates.
fullDescription: The Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme provides short-term credit requirements of farmers for cultivation of crops, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing, maintenance of farm assets, and allied activities. The scheme offers interest subvention of 2% and an additional 3% incentive for prompt repayment, effectively reducing the interest rate to 4% per annum.
benefits: Revolving credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% p.a. (with incentives)
Coverage for crop and allied activities
eligibility: SHG or Joint Liability Groups of farmers
financialBenefit: Credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
shortDescription: Digital marketplace connecting farmers with buyers across India for transparent pricing and better market access.
fullDescription: e-NAM is a pan-India electronic trading portal that networks the existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities. It provides a single window service for all APMC related information and services, including commodity arrivals & prices, buy & sell trade offers, and trade-related information services.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
shortDescription: Promotes organic farming through adoption of organic village by cluster approach and PGS certification.
fullDescription: PKVY aims at supporting and promoting organic farming and thereby improving soil health. Cluster of farmers are adopted with 50 or more farmers forming groups of 50 acres. All connected farmers of the group will be trained in the third year of implementation. ₹50,000 per hectare is provided over 3 years as financial assistance.
eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming
Groups of 50 or more farmers covering 50 acres

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
shortDescription: Provides medium-long term debt financing to build post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
fullDescription: AIF provides medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets through interest subvention and financial support. Projects eligible include primary processing centres, cold chains, warehouses, silos, pack houses, sorting & grading units, and assaying units.
benefits: 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹2 crore

name: National Food Security Mission
shortDescription: Increases production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals, and commercial crops through area expansion and productivity enhancement.
fullDescription: NFSM aims at increasing production of Rice, Wheat, Pulses, Coarse Cereals, and Nutri Cereals through area expansion and productivity enhancement in a sustainable manner; restoring soil fertility and productivity at the individual farm level; and enhancing farm level economy to restore confidence amongst the farmers.
benefits: Subsidy on farm machinery and tools
eligibility: Priority to small and marginal farmers

name: Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana
shortDescription: Empowers women farmers through capacity building, enabling them to participate in and benefit from agricultural and allied activities.
fullDescription: MKSP is a sub-component of DAY-NRLM that seeks to improve the current status of women in agriculture and to empower them for sustainable agriculture-based livelihoods. The programme focuses on women's collectives and supports sustainable agricultural practices, resource management, and leadership development.
benefits: Access to seeds, tools, and inputs
eligibility: Women farmers — individual or SHG members
Rural women with agriculture/allied activity involvement

name: Digital Agriculture Mission
shortDescription: Builds a national digital agriculture ecosystem to support AI-based crop planning, real-time advisory, and smart irrigation.
fullDescription: The Digital Agriculture Mission (2021-2025) focuses on building digital infrastructure through the Agri Stack — Farmers Database, Geo-referenced Village Maps, and Unified Farmer Service Interface. It also supports projects using AI, ML, IoT and drones in agriculture.
eligibility: State governments participating in the mission
